guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails at the step 'RUN git clone https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow.git /testbed/' with the error: 'fatal: destination path '/testbed' already exists and is not an empty directory.' This happens because the Dockerfile attempts to clone the repository into /testbed which either already exists or was created by a prior step (e.g., virtual environment creation). To fix this, modify the Dockerfile by removing or altering the way the repository is downloaded: either clean or remove /testbed directory before cloning, or clone into an empty directory. Alternatively, clone the repo first and then create the virtual environment inside the cloned directory, so the /testbed directory isn’t created prematurely. This will prevent the git clone command from failing due to the existing directory. Fixing this Dockerfile issue is essential because without a successful build, tests cannot be run.
